title: Brainrot Death Messages
description: Death messages inspired from trends, brainrots , and slangs.
body:
# Brainrot Death Messages

Turn boring Minecraft deaths into pure brainrot chaos.

## Commands

### `/brainrot start`
Enables Brainrot Death Messages.

### `/brainrot stop`
Disables Brainrot Death Messages.

## About

Brainrot Death Messages is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that replaces normal death messages with random meme-inspired messages based on how players died.

Inspired by Italian brainrot meme culture including:
- Tung Tung Sahur
- Tralalero Tralala
- Bombardiro Crocodilo
- Cappuccino Assassino
- Skibidi-style humor
- Sigma / aura / Ohio memes

## Features
- 100+ custom death messages
- Randomized messages
- Category based deaths
- PvP death messages
- Mob specific messages
- Fall damage messages
- Lava and fire messages
- Void messages
- Drowning messages
- Lightweight and optimized
- Supports modern Paper/Spigot servers
- Enable or disable the plugin in-game using commands

## Supported Death Types
- General deaths
- PvP
- Creeper deaths
- Zombie deaths
- Skeleton deaths
- Spider deaths
- Enderman deaths
- Fall damage
- Fire and lava
- Void
- Drowning

## Example Messages
- `<player> got tung tung sahur'd.`
- `<player> got mogged by gravity.`
- `<player> heard "tralalero tralala" before disappearing.`
- `<player> got fanum taxed by a creeper.`

## Compatibility
- Paper
- Spigot
- Purpur

## Performance
Designed to be lightweight with minimal server impact.

## Placeholder
Use `<player>` for automatic player name replacement.
